fields.description: Pier Point combines two residential towers with a garden podium at Rashid Yachts & Marina. One- to three-bedroom apartments sit alongside a small collection of three-bedroom townhouses. Yoga areas, shared gardens and barbecue spaces make the podium part of everyday life, while the townhouse plans separate upstairs bedrooms from the living spaces below.

overview: The brochure describes two towers sharing a landscaped podium rather than two isolated buildings. The residential offer ranges from smaller apartments to two-level homes with substantial outdoor areas. Marina and skyline outlooks depend on the particular home, and access to the wider waterfront district is separate from the facilities inside the residential development.
research.locationNote: Pier Point is in Rashid Yachts & Marina, Mina Rashid, Dubai. Emaar references the QE2 Hotel and connections towards Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport. Check the chosen building and unit orientation when comparing views and access.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s reviewed page displays selected homes from AED 3,193,888 while retaining a launch headline of AED 1.93m. Both tower fact sheets list launch starts of AED 1.93m for one bedroom, AED 2.87m for two, AED 4.07m for three and AED 8.73m for three-bedroom townhouses. Current quotations need confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The branded launch schedule is 80/20: eight 10% payments including the initial September 2024 payment, then 20% at completion. Property Finder also lists a 90/10 alternative for Pier Point 1, which the reviewed launch sheet does not establish. Confirm the plan attached to the selected unit.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment document estimates October 2028 completion. Property Finder reports the same month for both towers. Treat this as a schedule to verify against the contract, not a completion guarantee.

facts.label: Pier Point 1 launch mix
facts.value: 57 one-bedroom, 51 two-bedroom and nine three-bedroom apartments, plus five townhouses: 122 homes. This is a project composition, not remaining inventory.

facts.label: Pier Point 2 launch mix
facts.value: 56 one-bedroom, 51 two-bedroom and ten three-bedroom apartments total 117 apartments. Four townhouses in the same fact table bring the combined count to 121.

facts.label: Townhouse living arrangement
facts.value: Pier Point 1 Type A.1 places all three bedrooms upstairs. Below are living/dining, kitchen, maid’s room, laundry, storage and terrace. Its 2,667.19 sq ft total includes 467.37 sq ft of outdoor area.

facts.label: Pier Point 2 townhouses differ
facts.value: The separate plans identify TH02/03 as Type A.1, TH01 as A.2 and TH04 as A.3. TH04 totals 2,709.49 sq ft, including 496.75 sq ft of outdoor area.
